name: Acepromazine
aliases: Ace, ACP, Acetazine, Acetopromazine, Acetylpromazine, Acezine 2, Atravet
summary: Acepromazine, acetopromazine, or acetylpromazine is a phenothiazine derivative antipsychotic drug. It was used in humans during the 1950s as an antipsychotic, but is now almost exclusively used on animals as a sedative and antiemetic. A closely related analogue, chlorpromazine, is still used in humans.

pharmacology.text: The clinical pharmacology of acepromazine is similar to that of other phenothiazine derived anti-psychotic agents. The primary behavioral effects are attributed to its potent antagonism of post-synaptic D2 receptors and, to a lesser degree, the other D2-like receptors.

uses.text: It was used in humans during the 1950s as an antipsychotic, but is now almost exclusively used on animals as a sedative and antiemetic. A closely related analogue, chlorpromazine, is still used in humans. The standard pharmaceutical preparation, acepromazine maleate, is used in veterinary medicine in dogs and cats.

sideEffects.text: Side effects are not common, but the use of acepromazine in stallions should be used with caution (but is not absolutely contraindicated) due to the risk of paraphimosis and priapism, as well as penile prolapse. Acepromazine also lowers blood pressure, and should therefore be used with caution in horses that are experiencing anemia, dehydration, shock, or colic. It should not be used in horses dewormed with piperazine.

summaryZh: 乙醯丙嗪是一種橙黃色油狀液體。沸點220-240℃。其馬來酸鹽為黃色結晶，熔點135-136℃，溶於水，0.1%的水溶液pH為5.2，無臭。味苦。用途與氯丙嗪相似，但安定作用比氯丙嗪弱，療效較差。用於鎮靜、抗精神病、鎮吐、鎮痛和抗驚厥等。與止痛藥、催眠藥、局部麻醉藥等合用時能加強其作用。
